mentions.name: NewFeed
mentions.description: A web tool that turns a project's GitHub release notes into user-facing changelogs that users actually want to read.
mentions.problem: GitHub release notes aren't written in a form that end users want to read.
mentions.audience: Software project maintainers and teams sharing product updates with their users
